messages:
Maya: quick sync — posting updated company OKR draft for next quarter focused on Serving Reliability, Cost Efficiency, and Private deployments. need decision on priority order and launch criteria.
Jordan: skimmed. main tradeoff is reliability work vs dedicated capacity cadence. can we phase reliability rollouts so we hit SLOs without blocking Dedicated GA?
Samira: ops note — we need clear rollback triggers in the OKR for any infra change. can't signoff without thresholds & runbook refs.
Kevin: sales perspective: customers in finance want Private earlier; if we push Private to Q2, we risk losing deals. need a clear anchor-customer commitment.
Olivia: GTM note — to commit to Private we need enterprise-ready docs + compliance checklist. timeline will affect messaging and enablement.
Maya: proposal: prioritize Reliability (p95 latency < 150ms, error rate < 0.1%) as the company objective for Q1; Dedicated GA remains targeted for Q1 but as a limited beta; Private shifts to Q2 with 2 anchor customers. thoughts?
Jordan: agree on centering reliability but 150ms p95 is optimistic for long contexts. suggest split SLOs by model class: small models (<100 tokens) p95 < 120ms; medium (<500 tokens) p95 < 200ms; large (>500 tokens) p95 < 350ms.
Samira: approved thresholds only if we include circuit-breaker criteria: 5xx rate > 0.5% over 1h OR rolling p95 > 200ms for 10m -> pause rollout and rollback plan triggered.
Kevin: anchor customers: BankCorp and MediCloud are already in NDA and running evals. I can prioritize demos this month if Private Q2 is the plan.
Olivia: ok with Q2 Private but we need a launch kit by week 6 of the quarter: 1) compliance checklist, 2) install & ops guide, 3) PS engagement plan, 4) customer onboarding checklist.
Maya: decision draft: 1) priority order = Reliability, Cost Efficiency, Private Deployments. 2) Dedicated GA launch criteria = 2-week stable canary at 90% of target throughput + latency SLOs within 20% of baseline. 3) Private go/no-go = 2 anchor customers + compliance checklist + security signoff.
Jordan: small ask: define Dedicated throughput target — propose 10k tokens/s per cluster as an initial target and document autoscaling behavior for spikes.
Samira: add: Private must support configurable debug log retention (opt-in) and KMS integration. Security team signoff required before customer installs.
Maya: action items: Jordan -> refine SLOs by model class (due Thu); Samira -> draft rollback/runbook bullets and circuit-breaker playbook (due Wed); Kevin -> confirm anchor commitments and timelines (due Fri); Olivia -> outline launch kit scope and draft comms calendar (due Fri). I'll incorporate and push updated OKR doc.
Kevin: +1 to action items. please flag to exec that anchor-customer path is the commercial gating item.
deploy-bot: Maya uploaded file: /docs/okr/q3_goals_v2.md — access: internal only.
Olivia: :thumbsup: will prep comms calendar and enablement playbook once scope confirmed.
Maya: ok will loop exec for formal signoff Monday 09:00 PT after updates. anyone object to the priority order?
Jordan: no objections.
Samira: no objections but will withhold final signoff until runbook exists.
Kevin: no objections, contingent on anchor deals closing.
Olivia: no objections.
Maya: thanks — locking this draft for exec review Monday. I'll post the updated doc and PR for comments.
